summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed after print): joins str(obj) of each object with sep, then calls self.print once with end, style, highlight passed through and emoji=False, markup=False, no_wrap=True, overflow="ignore", crop=False. Signature defaults: sep=" ", end="\n", style=None, highlight=True (Optional[bool]). Added tests in tests/test_console.py (test_out plus test_out_no_objects, markup, emoji, containers, style, highlight_default/none/false, render_hook), with RenderHook and Text imports at the top. Added "Added Console.out" to CHANGELOG.md Unreleased Added list, and a "Low level output" section after Logging in docs/source/console.rst. Tests were not run, per instructions; nothing was committed.
